Chapter 2: Power of Tangent Function | Page 33

Home Work 07
Problem Statement Tangent Square Derivative
Find the derivative with respect to xxx of the function:
y=3tan⁡2xy = 3\tan^2 xy=3tan2x
STEP 1 প্রদত্ত ত্রিকোণমিতিক ঘাত ফাংশনটি উল্লেখ করি (Given Function)
y=3tan⁡2x=3(tan⁡x)2y = 3\tan^2 x = 3(\tan x)^2y=3tan2x=3(tanx)2
STEP 2 উভয়পক্ষে xxx-এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরণ করি (Differentiating both sides w.r.t. xxx)
dydx=ddx[3(tan⁡x)2]=3⋅ddx[(tan⁡x)2]\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{d}{dx}\left[ 3(\tan x)^2 \right] = 3 \cdot \frac{d}{dx}\left[ (\tan x)^2 \right]dxdy​=dxd​[3(tanx)2]=3⋅dxd​[(tanx)2]
STEP 3 শক্তি বিধি ও চেইন রুল প্রয়োগ করি (ddx[u2]=2ududx\frac{d}{dx}[u^2] = 2u \frac{du}{dx}dxd​[u2]=2udxdu​)
dydx=3×2(tan⁡x)2−1⋅ddx(tan⁡x)=6tan⁡x⋅ddx(tan⁡x)\frac{dy}{dx} = 3 \times 2(\tan x)^{2 - 1} \cdot \frac{d}{dx}(\tan x) = 6\tan x \cdot \frac{d}{dx}(\tan x)dxdy​=3×2(tanx)2−1⋅dxd​(tanx)=6tanx⋅dxd​(tanx)
STEP 4 অভ্যন্তরীণ ট্যানজেন্ট ফাংশনের অন্তরক নির্ণয় করি (Differentiating Inner Tangent Function)
ddx(tan⁡x)=sec⁡2x\frac{d}{dx}(\tan x) = \sec^2 xdxd​(tanx)=sec2x
STEP 5 মান বসিয়ে চূড়ান্ত অন্তরজ পাই (Final Product Form)
dydx=6tan⁡xsec⁡2x\frac{dy}{dx} = 6\tan x \sec^2 xdxdy​=6tanxsec2x
FINAL ANSWER dydx=6tan⁡xsec⁡2x\frac{dy}{dx} = 6\tan x \sec^2 xdxdy​=6tanxsec2x

📌 Box 1: Formulation & Tangent Power Rules
  • Power Chain Formula: ddx[ctan⁡nx]=cntan⁡n−1xsec⁡2x\frac{d}{dx}[c \tan^n x] = c n \tan^{n-1} x \sec^2 xdxd​[ctannx]=cntann−1xsec2x.
  • For c=3c = 3c=3 and n=2n = 2n=2: dydx=3×2tan⁡2−1xsec⁡2x=6tan⁡xsec⁡2x\frac{dy}{dx} = 3 \times 2 \tan^{2-1} x \sec^2 x = 6\tan x \sec^2 xdxdy​=3×2tan2−1xsec2x=6tanxsec2x
  • Alternative Sine-Cosine Form: 6tan⁡xsec⁡2x=6(sin⁡xcos⁡x)(1cos⁡2x)=6sin⁡xcos⁡3x6\tan x \sec^2 x = 6\left(\frac{\sin x}{\cos x}\right)\left(\frac{1}{\cos^2 x}\right) = \frac{6\sin x}{\cos^3 x}6tanxsec2x=6(cosxsinx​)(cos2x1​)=cos3x6sinx​
⚠️ Box 2: Common Student Traps & Pitfalls
  • Confusing tan⁡2x\tan^2 xtan2x with tan⁡(x2)\tan(x^2)tan(x2): ddx(tan⁡2x)=2tan⁡xsec⁡2x\frac{d}{dx}(\tan^2 x) = 2\tan x \sec^2 xdxd​(tan2x)=2tanxsec2x, whereas ddxtan⁡(x2)=2xsec⁡2(x2)\frac{d}{dx}\tan(x^2) = 2x\sec^2(x^2)dxd​tan(x2)=2xsec2(x2).
  • Forgetting the Constant 3: Multiplying 2tan⁡x2\tan x2tanx without multiplying by the existing coefficient 333, leaving an incomplete answer of 2tan⁡xsec⁡2x2\tan x \sec^2 x2tanxsec2x.
🌐 Box 3: Real Domain & Asymptotes
  • Domain of Definition: The tangent and secant functions are undefined where cos⁡x=0\cos x = 0cosx=0. Thus: Domain=R∖{x∈R:x=π2+kπ,k∈Z}\text{Domain} = \mathbb{R} \setminus \left\{ x \in \mathbb{R} : x = \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi, k \in \mathbb{Z} \right\}Domain=R∖{x∈R:x=2π​+kπ,k∈Z}
  • Vertical Asymptotes: At x=π2+kπx = \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pix=2π​+kπ, y→+∞y \to +\inftyy→+∞ and dydx→±∞\frac{dy}{dx} \to \pm\inftydxdy​→±∞.
  • Stationary Points: dydx=0  ⟺  tan⁡x=0  ⟺  x=kπ\frac{dy}{dx} = 0 \iff \tan x = 0 \iff x = k\pidxdy​=0⟺tanx=0⟺x=kπ. At these points, y=0y = 0y=0 (global minimum).
💡 Box 4: Leibniz Substitution (Alternative Verification)
  • Let u=tan⁡x  ⟹  y=3u2u = \tan x \implies y = 3u^2u=tanx⟹y=3u2.
  • dydu=6u\frac{dy}{du} = 6ududy​=6u.
  • dudx=sec⁡2x\frac{du}{dx} = \sec^2 xdxdu​=sec2x.
  • By Chain Rule: dydx=dydu⋅dudx=6u⋅sec⁡2x=6tan⁡xsec⁡2x\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy}{du} \cdot \frac{du}{dx} = 6u \cdot \sec^2 x = 6\tan x \sec^2 xdxdy​=dudy​⋅dxdu​=6u⋅sec2x=6tanxsec2x
